title: Album
description: Music album collection with artist, genre, release information, track count, duration, pricing, and ratings. Used for music streaming platforms, record stores, and music databases.

artist.description: Name of the artist or band who created the album

genre.description: Music genre (e.g., Rock, Pop, Jazz, Classical, Electronic)

release_date.description: Date when the album was originally released

label.description: Record label or music company that released the album

tracks.description: Total number of tracks or songs on the album

rating.description: Average user or critic rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

currency.description: ISO currency code for the album price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

cover.description: URL to the album cover art image
